text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Rose Kingdom had
drawn to
a close. On one such day off,
at her request,
we had made our way to a bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—I see.
Then, with this one...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That one is quite intriguing as well.

The book she is examining seems to be...
related to 'retired Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My thanks for the guidance.
...How calming.
Perhaps I strained my eyes a bit too much
from reading.
This feels as though it will thoroughly
relieve my fatigue.

As her shoulders relaxed, I replied,
'That is wonderful to hear'—and then,
I recalled how she had looked at the bookstore
earlier.

Truth be told, today wasn't the only time
I had seen her looking things up like
that.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Actually,
I have been thinking about whether there
might be
a way to connect retired Umamusume in some
form.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Throughout my journey in the Twinkle
Series,
I have relied on the help of countless people
and fellow Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Founding the Rose Kingdom,
establishing its presence,
and guiding it toward tranquility—
none of this could have been achieved
alone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to apply what I have learned here
for the sake of the racing world as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Retired Umamusume pursue a wide variety of
professions.
If we can all join hands,
we should be able
to achieve even greater things.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Fortunately,
I am surrounded by a great variety of
people. Perhaps with their cooperation,
we could... though,
it is still merely in the conceptual
stage.

As ever,
watching her strive so earnestly for someone
else's sake is dazzling.

Thinking of the future slowly opening before
her,
a smile naturally slipped onto my lips—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No—to tell the truth,
that is already the fourth time I have heard
such words today.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I gathered as much from the materials
you were looking into, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Presumptuous as it may be,
I do have a few connections.
If there is anything I can do to assist,
please do not hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
For retired Umamusume...
So my assumption was not mistaken after
all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you require assistance,
please do not hesitate to ask.
Drafting detailed schedules is something of
a specialty of mine.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If it's materials of that sort,
I've seen some in our school's storeroom.
Want me to take you there sometime?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well,
yeah...
our school has a few retired Umamusume and
those who stepped back from the front lines,
here and there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It is no stranger's affair to me.
I shall play this card for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...A gracious offer.
I am sure I will rely on everyone's help at
some point or another.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still,
I had no intention of saying it aloud...
Everyone, yourself included,
is remarkably perceptive.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
On top of that,
they even extend a helping hand.
Just like the members of the Rose Clan...
I am truly,
deeply blessed by those around me.

text_block_list.text:
Her earnest demeanor,
overflowing with love for others,
makes one instinctively want to reach out
a hand.

Surely,
her classmates couldn't help but call out
to her as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: After all, I had the privilege of ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh, and look at you.
You have certainly found your voice.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, but...
could we stop by the bookstore once more
later?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I would like to hear your thoughts.
